name: Maple Ridge Outdoor
description: Your gateway to adventure, inspired by the Canadian wilderness.
story: Maple Ridge Outdoor is a Canadian brand dedicated to providing high-quality outdoor gear and apparel. We believe in the spirit of exploration and adventure, and see motorsport as a perfect platform to showcase our brand's values of resilience, precision, and a passion for pushing boundaries. We seek a partnership that highlights our commitment to quality and inspires others to embrace the great outdoors.
